criteria.name: S0_1_lock_reproduces
criteria.detail: A_BOTH_OFF eval freeze-active fraction (per env step) >= 0.80 on >= 2 of 3 seeds; measured = 2nd-best seed

criteria.name: S0_2_lock_ratio_bounded
criteria.detail: median of z_harm_a_norm/(theta*gaba_tone) on fresh frozen gate ticks, A_BOTH_OFF pooled over seeds; alpha = smallest of {1,2,4} with 1+alpha >= median; median > 5 -> inert

criteria.name: S0_3_reach_in_regime
criteria.detail: D_BOTH_ON, path ON alpha 0: eval delta of _pag_desc_n_drive_steps_while_frozen >= 1 on >= 2 of 3 seeds; measured = 2nd-best seed

criteria.name: S0_5_reach_arm_lock_headroom
criteria.detail: NOT pre-registered (red-team F1, added pre-run): D_BOTH_ON eval freeze-active fraction, 2nd-best seed. Stage 1's P1 lives in D_BOTH_ON; below 0.80 PASS is sub-labelled stage0_pass_reach_arm_lock_weak. Does not change PASS.

criteria.name: S0_4_budget_warmup_episode_seconds
criteria.detail: worst-cell mean wall-clock seconds per warmup episode

combination_rule: PASS = pag_gate_ticked_in_eval AND S0_1 AND S0_2 AND S0_3 (plain AND); S0_4 informational

preconditions.name: pag_gate_ticked_in_eval
preconditions.description: every cell's PAG freeze gate ticked at least once in eval (the instrument all three criteria read is live)
preconditions.control: the gate ticks on every E3 tick when use_pag_freeze_gate is on

preconditions.name: reach_arm_path_constructed_at_alpha0
preconditions.description: D_BOTH_ON reports the descending-release path enabled with alpha 0 (so S0-3 reads a live counter at bit-identical behaviour)

preconditions.name: lock_ratio_identity_holds
preconditions.description: exit_threshold == theta_freeze*gaba_tone on every frozen tick (override 0, alpha 0), so the ratio is the pre-registered one
preconditions.control: SD-037 not constructed; alpha_descending 0 (a consistency check, tautological at this config -- not evidence)

preconditions.name: reach_arm_frozen_in_eval
preconditions.description: D_BOTH_ON froze (>= 1 frozen gate tick) in eval on >= 2 of 3 seeds; S0-3's counter increments only while frozen, so a zero with this unmet reads 'never frozen', not 'not reached'

routing.precondition_failed_no_lock_comparator: lock DV has no comparator on STAY substrate; MECH-287 lock falsifier routes back to the user (option A or C of the 2026-09-25 decision). Not a falsification.
routing.inert_by_magnitude: median lock ratio > 5: path cannot reach the lock at a bounded gain; Stage 1 does not run.
routing.precondition_failed_no_lock_comparator_l: S0-1 per-step fraction < 0.80 but lock_persistence >= 0.80 on >= 2 seeds: the lock exists once entered, entry is late. Same route (user decision) but the fraction-after-entry readout is the lead.
routing.reach_arm_never_frozen_in_eval: D_BOTH_ON did not freeze in eval; S0-3 zero is uninformative about reach. Not a falsification.
routing.stage0_pass_reach_arm_lock_weak: Stage 0 passed as pre-registered, but D_BOTH_ON's lock is below 0.80 so Stage 1's P1 may lack headroom; flag before queuing Stage 1.
routing.path_built_not_reached_in_regime: no invalidation while frozen in eval; built but not reached. Not a falsification.
routing.stage0_pass: queue Stage 1 (2x2x3, path eval-only ON at alpha_selected).
routing.lock_ratio_cannot_determine: fewer than MIN_FROZEN_GATE_TICKS frozen gate ticks pooled.
routing.substrate_not_ready_requeue: PAG gate never ticked in eval.

threshold_derivation.LOCK_FREEZE_FRACTION_FLOOR: design section 6 Stage 0 item 1 (0.80; 475 ref 1.0 under UP defect)
threshold_derivation.MIN_FROZEN_GATE_TICKS: driver-level cannot-determine floor for a median (10)

known_substrate_limitations: SD-018 / SD-106 (degrading, open): resource-proximity head is armed here.
